description:
Erection of a two storey lower ground and ground floor rear infill
and rear extension, side roof dormer extension and rear roof dormer extension
and installation of five roof lights to the house.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  323-PL-01, 323-PL-02, 323-PL-03, 323-PL-04, 323-PL-05, 323-PL-06, 323-PL-07, 323-PL-08, 323-PL-09, 323-SU-01, 323-SU-02, 323-SU-03, 323-SU-04, 323-SU-05, 323-SU-09, 323-SU-L01, 323-SU-L02  Received:  25 August 2026.  

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The side casement window of the side roof dormer extension to the house hereby permitted shall be non-openable, obscure glazed and be permanently retained as such.  

Reasons:  To protect the privacy of neighbouring residential properties.

Condition : 5 - During works, an appropriate wheel-washing system shall be operated to remove mud, stones and other extraneous materials from vehicle wheels and chassis' leaving the site, and all departing loads shall be fully covered to ensure no material is deposited on the highway.  The exit from the wheel wash shall be a hard, non-porous surface sited as far away from the exit as is possible given the site constraints and kept clean at all times.  Waste water discharged from the wheel wash shall be stored and disposed of on site and not discharged into the public sewer unless soil, stones and any suspended material have first been removed.  

The developer shall ensure that no dust or other debris are carried on to adjoining properties in accordance with the guidance at https://www.london.gov.uk/file/18750/download?token=zV3ZKTpP.  

Site lighting shall be designed, positioned and directed so as not to unnecessarily intrude on passing drivers or direct light into any neighbouring windows in accordance with the guidance provided by the Institute of Lighting Engineers Guidance Note: For The Reduction Of Obtrusive Light 2021.  

All vehicle arrivals and departures shall be supervised and the condition of the highway examined immediately afterwards.  Any materials shed from the vehicle during such movement shall be immediately removed from the highway, and returned to site or carted away for disposal and shall not be washed into the surface water drainage system.  

Reason:  In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and in the interests of highway safety.  

Notes:

For the wheel washing system above, the preferred distance between it and the exit to the highway is 100 metres if this is practicable.  

If site staff are instructed by a Council Officer to stop vehicle movements to and from the site if any incidents occur, they must comply with the instructions.  For any further advice, contact the Council's Community Environment Team on 020 8583 5070.

Condition : 6 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.

Reason: In order to protect the living conditions of neighbouring residents.

Condition : 7 - The arboricultural protection measures proposed for application to the house's rear garden Elder (TR01) and Beech (TR02) trees by the submitted Tree Report (Ref: 323-TR-001 Date: 25 August 2026) shall be fully adhered to throughout construction works for the development hereby permitted.  

Reasons:  To protect the health and longevity of trees protected by Wellesley Road Conservation Area within the site.
